conf.description: Exchange admin-audit / other (XML): New-AdminAuditLogSearch XML with repeating CmdletParameters/Parameter and ModifiedProperties/Property children. No serde type or pack covers XML, so this pipeline uses the code function to regex-extract the top-level attributes and flatten each repeating block into a bounded array (cap 20).

conf.comment: exchange / admin-audit / other. Bespoke XML parse per parsing.notes (no Elastic integration covers on-prem admin audit). Uses code (not serde, which has no XML type) to pull Caller/Cmdlet/ObjectModified/RunDate/Succeeded/Error/OriginatingServer and to flatten CmdletParameters/Parameter and ModifiedProperties/Property into bounded name/value arrays. Field names assume the Search-AdminAuditLog XML path; the rendered MSExchange Management event-log text path (mentioned as an alternative in route_direct) is NOT this pipeline's input shape.
